notes.1: Close. Beat landing is not stated, the exception appears only in §3/§8, and 'data as solid shapes' leans toward the charts the original warns against.
notes.2: Close. No spread (programme page / artifact page), no baseline grid, and no 2D camera matrix with scale and rotation.
notes.3: Close. Red is fixed and the signal is confined to a square drawn above the type; the original lets it be red, orange, ultramarine or green, and allows black type on it.
notes.4: Close. Word-by-word clip reveal of subtitles and optically flush-left numerals are missing.
notes.5: House bezier, no overshoot, clip-rise, baseline growth, fold and the linear exception are right. But durations are not note values landing on the beat, slots get a third curve (power4.out) against 'two curves only', and ripples run left to right rather than by distance from their cause.
notes.6: Locked spread and page slide match, but 'never zoom, never rotate' and 'no wipes' contradict the original's rotate 90°, push/pull moves and wipe transitions.
notes.8: Close. The programme move and snap = beat are missing.
notes.10: Columns, guides, grow, slot, fold and caption cover the parts. But there is no snap that lands on a beat (timing is in seconds), no knife line or linear exception track, and slot bakes in a third curve.
notes.11: Close. Signal colour and 'the exception or none' are not listed as choices.
